propositions: The AC1 contract test currently re-calls the same composer in MCP and reconciler blocks instead of invoking real entry points, making assertions trivially true and unable to catch parity bugs
The contract must drive real MCP server via build_server() and call_tool() and real reconciler via main() argv to capture actual composed snapshots at those surfaces

The contract must anchor each surface's snapshot to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config key provenance) beyond just cross-surface comparison to prevent the vacuity where perturbing the composer makes all surfaces move together

The contract must verify that the capture recorder fires for each surface, failing explicitly if that surface no longer routes through the shared composer, to distinguish a non-firing spy from a passing assertion
MCP and reconciler surfaces must pass different inputs (project layer and env layer) than CLI to reflect their real call sites, which do not accept cli_overrides
